summary: AAPResourcePicker fetches AAP resources (inventories, organizations, credentials) from the AAP API for selection. Properties: title, description, ui:field: AAPResourcePicker, resource (type to fetch), idKey (default id), nameKey (default name), and type: array for multi-select.
